landing.subtitle: Token Bag
landing.description: Press start, then set up your bag and draw your results. All the game's base mechanics are currently covered — if you have any bug reports or suggestions, message me on Discord at Amnuve.
landing.helpLink: You can buy the official materials here

setup.description: Choose the number of traits in play, the difficulty of the test, how many tokens to draw, and optionally set the confused status or adrenaline (Danger is not handled directly: it depends on the game master and doesn't affect the draw).
setup.trattiHint: Normal: +1 white per trait. Confusion: trait tokens are randomly drawn as white or black.
setup.confusioneLabel: Trait tokens will be randomly white or black, instead of guaranteed white

estrazione.description: Draw your tokens and see the result! If you're not satisfied, you can risk it to try to reach your goal!
estrazione.rischiaWarning: If you risk it, you give the narrator all the black tokens drawn. Only risk it if it's truly important!
estrazione.nascondiConseguenze: Hide how to spend black tokens

consequences.title: Complication (affects the whole scene)
consequences.body: The Narrator complicates the scene: worsens the situation or raises narrative pressure.

consequences.title: Misfortune (to a single hero)
consequences.body: You gain a misfortune: it remains until resolved; when it comes into play, it adds black tokens to the bag.

consequences.title: Adrenaline
consequences.body: Put 1 black token on Adrenaline: in the next test you're forced to draw 4 tokens, then it's removed.

consequences.title: Confusion
consequences.body: Put 1 black token on Confusion: in the next test, traits don't grant guaranteed white tokens but random ones instead, then it's removed.

impostazioni.title: Settings
impostazioni.description: Here you'll find the app settings.
impostazioni.tokenCustomizationHint: Upload an image for the white and black tokens drawn from the bag. They stay saved on this device until you clear your browser cache.
impostazioni.imageRecommendation: Recommended: a square image with the subject centered, around 256x256px, in any common format (it will be converted and compressed automatically).
impostazioni.themeHint: Choose the app's color palette: changes background, text and details.

stanza.lobbyDescription: Create a room to be the master, or join an existing room with the code they shared with you. Nickname and avatar stay only on this device.
stanza.notFound: Room not found. Check the code.
stanza.shareCode: Share this code with the other players
stanza.waitingForMaster: Waiting for the master to start a test…

footer.line1: This tool was developed as a hobby project and not for profit.
